technical.summary: EPAM shows early momentum recovery signals (MACD/PPO crossovers) but lacks confluence with price structure; bearish technicals (below all MAs, negative CMF, Ichimoku below cloud) and weak volume suggest this is a false bounce rather than a high-probability swing entry.

fundamental.summary: EPAM shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and faces earnings in 14 days with elevated risk.

sentiment.congressional_conviction: medium — mixed signals with Republican senior member purchases offset by Democratic sale
sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (26/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is mixed and stale (150+ days old), while absent news sentiment limits conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (325.28) indicates extreme market stress, strong USD pressures multinational IT revenues, and earnings binary event in 14 days compounds volatility risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: MACD/PPO crossovers and Supertrend bullish signals combined with extreme fear (26/100 Fear/Greed) and contrarian sentiment create a potential capitulation bounce setup near support at 326.03.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price remains below all major moving averages with negative CMF, Ichimoku below cloud, weak volume (0.61 ratio), high earnings risk in 14 days, inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels (325.28), and strong USD headwinds—technical signals are false bounce noise in a severe macro downtrend.

decision.entry_rationale: MACD/PPO crossovers and extreme fear sentiment (26/100) suggest potential capitulation bounce, but this is contradicted by price below all major moving averages, negative CMF, and Ichimoku below cloud indicating structural weakness.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings binary event in 14 days combined with inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels (325.28), and strong USD headwinds create severe macro downside risk that outweighs technical bounce signals.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case; technical crossovers are false bounce noise in severe downtrend
decision.portfolio_note: Already 15 positions in Information Technology sector; adding EPAM increases concentration risk during macro crisis without conviction.
